The documents don't report championship results, so this answer relies on the teammate list plus outside knowledge of who won titles.

Daniel Ricciardo's teammates in the 2000–2025 period include Mark Webber, Sebastian Vettel, Daniil Kvyat, Max Verstappen, Jean-Éric Vergne, Nico Hülkenberg, Esteban Ocon, and Lando Norris. Of these, Vettel won four drivers' championships (2010–2013) and Verstappen won in 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024. Documents [1] to [8] do not show Ricciardo's teammates' title results, and no document lists Ricciardo's 2014–2018 Red Bull teammates.

Lando Norris, his McLaren teammate in 2021–2022, also won the 2025 title according to my own knowledge, but the provided documents don't cover that, so I have not included him.

ANSWER: Sebastian Vettel, Max Verstappen
